defaults.video_script: Manchester City drew at home and Erling Haaland completely lost it. He went straight at the referee on the whistle, shouting in his face while teammates tried to drag him away. The cameras caught every word of it. The FA charged him with improper conduct. He was fined and warned about his future behaviour. The calmest finisher in world football had snapped over two dropped points. He never publicly apologised.

videos.video_script: Manchester City drew at home and Erling Haaland completely lost it. He went straight at the referee on the whistle, shouting in his face while teammates tried to drag him away. The cameras caught every word of it. The FA charged him with improper conduct. He was fined and warned about his future behaviour. The calmest finisher in world football had snapped over two dropped points. He never publicly apologised.
